<!-- pr-reviewer: bd24b9328eef44fb694195d0b0241a308944bd8d -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The changes affect toolpaths, geometry, and verification without a solid mesh.
I checked the laws from upstream main `acd5b02d3e36a12745b11038012240781129d43c`.
The current diff includes the parent PR #2716, including its UI and process changes.

The pick seeds the slot in the command. The new tests check undo, slot dimensions, named refusals, and moved sketches.
The new contour and slot suites pass. The UI suites and clippy pass.

**Local build and tests**

The trial merge with upstream main failed in these files:

- `crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs`
- `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`
- `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/model_link.rs`

I aborted the trial merge. All results below are from the PR head, without that merge.
No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` selected the batch plan because geometry changed.
The local build passed. The gate completed all 916 steps: 914 passed and two failed. Clippy passed with `-D warnings`.

| Crate | Tests passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| geometry | 165 | 0 | 0 |
| kernel | 70 | 1 | 4 |
| cl | 69 | 0 | 0 |
| tools | 129 | 0 | 0 |
| post | 776 | 0 | 0 |
| sim | 726 | 0 | 4 |
| motion | 1163 | 0 | 22 |
| app | 3951 | 1 | 43 |
| ui | 1389 | 0 | 9 |

The two failed tests are:

- `camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`: `step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name`. The fixture `bar_cross_holes.step` has no row.
- `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: `no_pickable_edge_is_a_tangent_piece_of_a_longer_one_in_any_step_fixture`.

```text
crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs:466:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: a fixture has no row, or a row has no fixture - re-triage

crates/app/tests/feature_edge_g1_join.rs:94:5:
tangent pieces of one edge pick apart: [
    "bar_cross_holes.step: 116 pairs, first (97186, 97189)",
]
```

These are failures on the PR head. This review does not identify them as regressions from the slot commit.
Current upstream main has the missing STEP row. The PR body already identifies the feature-edge failure and its upstream fix.
The conflicting combined tree remains unverified.

**Extra suites run**

- Golden reader: `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test slot_dxf_sketch`, run separately after the gate: four passed.
- The changed golden files have one reader: `crates/app/tests/slot_dxf_sketch.rs`.
- The gate also ran `camcraft-kernel --test step_agreement`, `camcraft-kernel --test machining_mesh`, and `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join` by name.
- `machining_mesh`: seven passed. The other two results are above.

**Mutations and goldens**

I repeated two guard mutations in the review worktree:

| Mutation | Test | Mutated | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| M3: disable centerline straightness | `a_bent_short_or_doubled_centerline_is_refused_by_name` | failed as expected | passed |
| M4: disable the centerline ends law | `a_centerline_room_holds_its_two_ends_and_refuses_other_ends` | failed as expected | passed |

Both are motion library tests. Each mutation returned exit 101 from the named assertion. Each restored test returned exit 0.
All temporary changes were restored. The source diff is empty.

No existing golden changed. I checked every line of both new CL goldens: nine slot moves and 406 trochoidal moves.
An additional numeric check sampled each cutting segment and arc sweep against the expected cutter-center stadium.
The maximum center distance from its axis was 3.000 mm for Slot and 3.001 mm for Trochoidal Slot.
The check allowed 0.002 mm for the recorded CL rounding.
No new posted NC sample was checked by hand. The existing post suites ran.

**Requested before merge**

1. Resolve the four merge conflicts at the permitted refresh step. Reconcile the format at `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:153`.
   Both branches use version 73 for different fields. Keep main's protected-feature data and the sketch data during migration.
   Then run the two failed suites and the quick gate on the combined final head. Both failed suites block this review.
2. Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the UI changes, including `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs:139`.
   The current body has none. Link the images from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
3. Add `Process change: yes` to the PR body. The current diff changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:160`.
   The body currently says no process file changed. The merging session handles `PROCESS_VERSION`.
4. Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head and record their results in the body.
   The geometry and motion changes, including `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room_line.rs:17`, reach the motion and app heavy lanes.
   Use `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` after the refresh. These lanes were not run here and have no results in the body.
   Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires them before readiness.

The review state is `needs-rework` and `conflicts`. The PR remains a draft.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
